description: This file provides utility functions for generating and validating IDs related to workflows, executions, runs, and agentfield request IDs within the control plane's utils package.

methods.name: GenerateWorkflowID
methods.description: Generates a new unique workflow ID based on current timestamp and a random string.

methods.name: GenerateExecutionID
methods.description: Generates a new unique execution ID based on current timestamp and a random string.

methods.name: GenerateRunID
methods.description: Generates a new unique run ID based on current timestamp and a random string.

methods.name: GenerateAgentFieldRequestID
methods.description: Generates a new agentfield request ID based on current timestamp and a random string.

methods.name: ValidateWorkflowID
methods.description: Validates the format of a workflow ID.

methods.name: generateRandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length, using crypto/rand if available, otherwise falls back to math/rand.
